answer: Proof-of-personhood needs two signatures from existing members, then converts into a vesting stream that unlocks over 100 epochs. Budget it in hours: a member spends about 20 minutes checking a new identity, the vesting costs the recruit nothing but patience, and a farm's 1,000 accounts need 2,000 signatures from people who risk their own standing. That is 667 hours of attention no script can fake. A relic of the old one-time signup gets nobody to the summit at epoch 100, and a lagoon of idle accounts never reaches it.
